scorecard.note: Every listed setup is a call, written down before the outcome and scored as a reader could trade it: a buy that waits for a daily close fills at the next session's open, a daily close below the out line sells at the next open, the target when it trades, the time stop at the close of twice the horizon, at most 40 sessions (a wave call's measured to its second target). A wave call takes a fifth off at its first target and holds the rest for its second. Earlier calls keep the rule they were listed with: filled and sold at that close.

move.method: VIX close / 15.87: about 81% of days stay inside this move (not 68%). The 68% band is the HAR forecast of the S&P's volatility x 0.88.

fear.method: Fear day = the Buy List's rule: SPY fell 1% or more on the day, or closed under its 50-day average (or a volatility spike). Stress is a separate word from the VIX (under 15 calm, 15 to 18.5 normal, over 18.5 stressed) beside a HAR forecast of the S&P's realized volatility.

day.method: gamma sign, gap and range so far against the expected move

tape.delay: the session's prints to the run; the side is signed against the latest quote
labels: side: signed against the latest quote (the options feed has no quote history); mid and unknown prints stay neutral
heat baselines: point-in-time expanding means over the contract's own earlier prints that day; avg_oi is the chain mean
algo ratio tallies are scaled x10 (the desk's choice); the buys-only variant is the vendor's intake, both are shown
multi-leg prints count in the totals and not in the net premium; cancelled prints are excluded entirely
opening or closing: asserted only where the day's numbers force it (volume above open interest; a bid-side print offset by earlier ask-side volume); otherwise unclear

avoid.removed: The small-cap 20-day-loser veto was removed: its sign flipped (+0.69% in discovery, -0.43% in holdout, not significant).
avoid.stacked: Four or more warnings together: -3.36% (t -3.3) discovery, -7.45% (t -8.2) holdout over 20 days.
avoid.text: SPY is over its 200-day, where the avoid veto has worked: do not buy a flagged name.
avoid.veto_value: Names that pass the avoid veto beat those that fail it by +6.9% (discovery) and +10.7% (holdout) over 60 days, net of costs (t 7.1 / 8.5); micro names +3.6% / +6.7%.

buy.caveat: Momentum and the momentum dip beat random picks; neither has been shown to beat SPY as a portfolio.
buy.text: Calm day: the buy-side features are graded on fear days (on all days their IC is near zero). The chips are information.

chips.caution: Fear days only; otherwise information. A plain pullback is refuted.
chips.evidence: Uptrend names on fear days: a deeper pullback than the stock's own norm ranks higher. IC +0.026 / +0.031 (t 4.3 / 4.3), same sign in both eras.
chips.label: Pullback deeper than its own usual

chips.caution: Fear days only. Raw log, no written study.
chips.evidence: Uptrend names on fear days: indiscriminate selling hurts names that did nothing wrong. IC +0.026 / +0.028; all days +0.001.
chips.label: Pullback that is the market's, not the company's

chips.evidence: Uptrend names on fear days: absorbed supply. IC +0.018 / +0.017; all days +0.008 / +0.006.
chips.label: Gap-downs bought back (10 sessions)

chips.caution: Deep resets only (35% under the high, near the low). Lower is better.
chips.evidence: Deep resets: laggards win. IC -0.041 in both eras (t -5.5 / -4.9).
chips.label: 10-day return vs SPY

chips.evidence: Deep resets: capitulation volume is better. IC +0.040 / +0.020; spreads +0.95 / +1.28 points.
chips.label: Selling volume vs the month before

chips.caution: A ranking tilt, never a buy signal: in small caps a tie-break only, and not shown to beat SPY as a portfolio.
chips.evidence: Liquid names: the top tenth beat the market by +15.4% / +20.8% over a 63-day hold.
chips.label: Six-month gain (126 days)

chips.caution: Beats random but not SPY: as a ladder its portfolio t is 1.2 and its Sharpe 0.85 is under SPY's 1.41. It does not beat SPY.
chips.evidence: Top 30% on six-month gain and bottom 30% on the 5-day return: +5.9% per trade over matched random picks on fear days (t 2.35).
chips.label: Momentum dip

chips.evidence: Quiet-day accumulation: above the 255-day average is +0.8 (t 6.2) in every tier, both eras.
chips.label: Negative volume index vs its 1-year average

chips.caution: Survivors-only study. The list is fetched weekly from a public source.
chips.label: S&P 500 member

chips.caution: Counts only while SPY is in that drawdown third (the banner says).
chips.evidence: In drawdowns yesterday's losers beat yesterday's winners: IC -0.058 / -0.028 in the deepest SPY-drawdown third.
chips.label: Last session's return

exit.text: Hold about 60 sessions from the next open and leave on time. Trailing stops, profit caps and early exits hurt: 159 of 159 significant trailing-stop results were harmful.

gaps: Repeat reverse splits: 1614 of 1814 names have not been checked yet.

items.changes: Marks every name's last-session move: while ON, yesterday's losers are the ones to favour over yesterday's winners.
